module: Manages the interface app layouts: reading, creating, copying, renaming, deleting and resetting `*.uilayout.json` files, as well as adding, removing and moving apps in a layout. The original layouts are in `/settings/ui_apps/originalLayouts/`, the user's in `/settings/ui_apps/layouts/`. A layout type to file table is stored in `/temp/ui-layout-map.json`. Used by modders who want to change the displayed apps by code; the Vue editor relies on the same functions.
usage:
local layouts = ui_appLayouts.getAvailableLayouts()
for _, l in ipairs(layouts) do print(l.filename, l.type, l.title) end
ui_appLayouts.setUsedLayout('freeroam')
notes: The official apps removed from the game (engineDebug, gravityApp, radioTest, simpleRpmDebug, replayAppV2) are filtered out of all layouts, including custom layouts; the `removedApps` list of an original layout is also used as an obsolescence list.
App indices are 0-based on the JS side: removeApp, applyPlacementPatch and applySettingsPatch convert them to a 1-based Lua index. A string of the form "appName-<idx>" is also accepted (0-based idx).

getAvailableLayouts updates the user files: if the original layout's `version` is newer, the user layout is replaced; otherwise the apps whose `appVersion` is newer are replaced or added. The file is then rewritten to disk.
Each returned layout gets the fields `filename`, `resettable`, `userFileExists` and possibly `default` (if the path contains "default").

addApp, removeApp and the patches write to disk without notification (silent write); saveLayout, createLayout, renameLayout, duplicateLayout, deleteLayout, resetLayout and setCurrentLayout notify `ui_apps.notifyLayoutsChanged`.
The onCameraChanged hook sends `PlayerCameraModeChanged` to the UI; a walking player is reported as camera "unicycle".

getAvailableLayouts.desc: Lists all available layouts (originals without a user copy + user files), after updating the user files from the originals and filtering out removed apps.

getCurrentLayout.desc: Returns the currently active layout (after filtering obsolete apps), or nil.

setCurrentLayout.desc: Sets the current layout from a file name or a layout table, then notifies the change. Returns nil if the file is not found.

layoutOrFilename.desc: Layout file path or layout table.

setUsedLayout.desc: Chooses the layout to use from a file name or a type. An explicit choice by file is stored as the type's preference, unless it is the type's default layout (the preference is then cleared).

idOrType.desc: Layout file name or layout type.

returns.desc: Activated layout, nil if not found.

resetUsedLayout.desc: Reloads the layout stored by setUsedLayout as the current layout. Returns the current layout as is if none was chosen.

saveLayout.desc: Saves a layout to disk (`filename` field required) then notifies the consumers.

createLayout.desc: Creates a new layout. Without `filename`, a free name is derived from the title in the user folder. Default title "My Layout", default type "custom".

data.desc: Optional fields: title, type, apps, description, devonly, version, filename.

returns.desc: Created file name, nil if no name is available.

renameLayout.desc: Changes a layout's title. Refuses layouts from the official content.

duplicateLayout.desc: Copies a layout to a new file (title "<title> copy" by default), removing the `default` flag.

returns.desc: File name of the copy, nil on failure.

deleteLayout.desc: Deletes a layout's file, unless it is part of the official content (a message is logged and nothing is deleted).

returns.desc: true if the layout was found (even if the deletion was refused), false otherwise.

resetLayout.desc: Resets a user layout by deleting its file, which makes the original reappear. Refuses files outside the user folder.

layoutType.desc: Type used to find the original if the file has none.

returns.desc: File name of the reset layout, or false on failure.

addApp.desc: Adds an app at the end of a layout, with optional placement. Refuses obsolete apps.

placement.desc: Position and size of the app.

removeApp.desc: Removes an app from a layout by index (0-based) or by "name-index" identifier.

applyPlacementPatch.desc: Replaces the placement of an app in a layout and writes the file.

applySettingsPatch.desc: Replaces the settings of an app in a layout and writes the file.

setEditing.desc: Enables or disables the layout edit mode.

isEditing.desc: Indicates whether the edit mode is active.

getPlayerCameraModes.desc: Returns the camera mode of each player (multi-seat); "unicycle" if the player is walking.

onCameraChanged.desc: Hook called when a player's camera changes. Sends `PlayerCameraModeChanged` to the UI with `{player, name}`.

setLayoutForType.desc: Stores the layout to use for a layout type.

getLayoutForType.desc: Returns the layout file stored for a type.

getTypeLayoutMap.desc: Returns a copy of the layout type to file table.
